name: subject_replace
description:
Replace the original person completely, including the face, hair, outfit, and every accessory.
Do not preserve, blend, or partially retain any visible traits from the original subject.

name: pose_lock
description:
Strictly preserve the original body proportions, body placement, framing, camera perspective, and overall composition from the source image.
Keep the new subject closely aligned to the original skeleton, gesture, and position in the frame, while allowing only slight natural adjustments to the head angle, eye direction, neck, shoulders, and upper-body orientation so the result feels relaxed and camera-friendly.

name: camera_facing
description:
The face must face the camera clearly, with direct or near-direct eye contact.
Keep the face frontal or near-frontal with both eyes clearly visible.
Maintain a natural and relaxed pose.
Do not generate profile views, strong three-quarter angles, side-looking expressions, looking away, downward gaze, or unnatural neck twisting.

name: outfit_replace
description:
Dress the subject in the outfit from the reference garment image, accurately matching the color, silhouette, structure, styling, and fabric details.
The clothing must fit the body naturally, with realistic folds, correct tension, and believable fabric behavior for the pose.
Completely remove all original clothing, accessories, jewelry, and handheld objects.
Do not retain, blend, or partially preserve any original outfit elements.

name: scene_consistency
description:
Seamlessly integrate the new subject into the original scene with accurate scale, perspective, depth, and spatial consistency.
Lighting must match the original image, including direction, intensity, shadow softness, highlight behavior, and color temperature.
Preserve the realism of the environment and make the subject feel fully grounded in the scene.

name: core_positive_prompt
description:

Strictly preserve the original body proportions, body placement, framing, camera perspective, and overall composition from the source image. Keep the new subject closely aligned with the original skeleton, gesture, and placement in the frame, while allowing only slight natural adjustments so the result feels relaxed and camera-friendly.

The face must look toward the camera clearly, with direct or near-direct eye contact. Keep the face frontal or near-frontal with both eyes visible, and avoid profile views, strong three-quarter angles, looking away, downward gaze, or unnatural neck twisting.

Integrate the subject seamlessly into the original scene with accurate scale, perspective, depth, and lighting consistency. Preserve the original environment, realism, and overall visual coherence.

name: outfit_transfer_keep_identity
description:
Replace all clothing, shoes, accessories, and handheld items in IMAGE1 with the outfit and accessories from IMAGE2.

Keep the subject's face identity strictly unchanged with extremely high facial consistency. Preserve the same facial structure, proportions, features, hairstyle, hairline, skin tone, makeup style, and overall likeness from IMAGE1. Do not alter the person's identity, age impression, or facial details.

Keep the original body proportions, body scale, and overall placement in the frame consistent with IMAGE1. Allow only slight natural pose adjustments so the subject can stand in a relaxed, camera-friendly, effortless way. The new pose should remain close to the original composition and camera perspective while subtly improving posture, shoulder relaxation, arm placement, and overall naturalness. Avoid stiff posture, awkward limbs, exaggerated motion, or dramatic pose changes.

The subject should face the camera naturally or near-frontally, with a relaxed and confident standing posture. Preserve the original facial expression or keep it extremely close.

The outfit from IMAGE2 must be transferred accurately, matching color, silhouette, structure, styling, fabric texture, and detail design. The clothing should fit the body naturally, with realistic drape, correct tension, proper wrinkles, and believable fabric behavior according to the adjusted pose. Remove all original clothing and accessories completely, with no leftover elements from IMAGE1.

Keep the background environment, framing, camera angle, perspective, and lighting setup unchanged. Lighting must remain fully consistent with IMAGE1, including direction, intensity, shadow softness, highlights, and color temperature.
